title: eval-adapter-and-profile-assembler-for-deterministic-model-onboarding
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Extend the benchmark harness so that model onboarding produces deterministic, signed performance profiles (latency, throughput, quality metrics) that can be pinned to a model version in the catalog. This ticket introduces an eval-adapter layer that ingests model metadata + artifact manifests, canonicalizes dataset/prompt inputs, enforces deterministic seeds and concurrency rules, and emits a machine-readable profile manifest (profile.json) alongside human-readable summary. The profile assembler must support: (1) multiple eval runners (local, k8s-batch, remote-ptm), (2) prompt/dataset normalization across tokenizers and different context-lengths, and (3) version pin metadata for model artifacts and quantization profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Harness produces a signed profile.json for a model artifact containing: model_id, model_version, quantization_profile, eval_commit_sha, dataset_checksums, per-scenario latency P50/P90/P99, tokens/sec, and quality metrics for each prompt set.
Profiles can be published via the existing model-catalog API and be used for pinning in the onboarding flow.
Deterministic handling: running the same harness inputs (seed + artifact) yields identical profile.json hash within CI across linux-x86_64 and linux-arm64 builders.
Support for pluggable eval runners: local-runner, k8s-runner (batch), and remote-runner (gpu farm) validated with smoke tests.
Documentation and a short runbook for resolving mismatched tokenization or seq-length bucket issues are added to Confluence.
Performance regression gate: profiles include baseline comparison to previous pinned profile and flag if tokens/sec decreases >10% or latency P90 regresses >15%.
Automated publishing step signs the profile using the platform CI key and uploads to catalog with metadata tags.
Unit and integration tests cover prompt normalization, seed determinism, and manifest schema validation.
tasks: Design eval-adapter API for ingesting model manifest and per-eval config (owner: Diego)
Implement prompt normalizer module: tokenize-with-fallback, pad/truncate policy, canonical canonicalization rules (owner: Priya)
Extend harness runner interface to return deterministic RNG state and raw-kv cache hotkeys (owner: Liam)
Profile assembler: JSON schema, signing integration, and publish step to model-catalog (owner: Diego)
Add CI smoke job that runs a lightweight eval on ci-small and verifies profile hash stability across runners (owner: CI Team)
Docs: Confluence runbook + example profiles + how to pin in onboarding UI (owner: Asha)
QA: cross-arch run verification (x86_64, arm64) and flakiness budget analysis (owner: QA)
Follow-up: create a migration plan for older profiles (unstructured) to new schema (owner: Platform)
Security review checkpoint for signing integration (owner: Security)
Optional: telemetry hook to Console to show 'profile confidence' score (P2 if time remains)
comments: 2025-02-10 Asha Menon: Created ticket after sync with PM and research. Initial owner assigned to Diego. Scope: harness + publishing flow.
2025-02-12 Diego Ramos: First pass API draft pushed to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/489 (WIP). Chose JSON profile manifest to keep backwards compatibility with catalog UI.

2025-02-14 Priya Kapoor: Design note - tokenizer edge cases observed with byte-level encodings for some open models; proposing a fallback to surrogate-token approach documented in confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MODEL/Tokenization+Fallbacks.
2025-02-17 Liam Chen: Implemented runner shim that exposes RNG seed and KV hotkeys; local smoke runner validated on ci-small. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/502.

2025-02-19 Diego Ramos: Decision - use JSON schema v1 for profile manifest and attach a signature file profile.json.sig instead of embedding signature; reason: simpler verification in external tools and avoids schema bloat.
2025-02-21 Security: Reviewed signing approach; requested HSM integration checklist before GA. Added Security action item to tasks.

2025-02-24 QA: Found non-determinism on arm64 when running k8s-runner concurrently; root cause appears to be non-deterministic batch ordering in the GPU farm runner. Mitigation: introduce explicit batch-sort by request-id in runner (temporary) and add integration test to detect reorderings.
2025-02-26 PM (Nina Patel): Approved scope for MVP for runtime-1.19 release. Requested baseline comparison rows be visible in Console dev-dashboard (follow-up ticket created).
2025-02-28 Diego Ramos: Merged prompt-normalizer and runner-shim to staging. CI smoke job added; two failing tests left (arm64 determinism, profile signing timeout in CI).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: binary protobuf manifests would be smaller and faster to validate but make human inspection harder; decided on JSON for ease of debugging and compatibility with existing catalog. We will revisit v2 with compressed protobuf if profile size becomes an operational issue.
risks: Non-determinism across hardware leading to flaky profile hashes
Tokenization mismatches causing spuriously low quality scores
CI signing key rotation causing automated publish failures
